messages.content: "你能幫我計算相變所需的能量嗎？我有一個科學實驗，首先我要將500克冰在攝氏0度下融化，然後再冷凍回去。之後，我要將同樣質量的水在攝氏100度下蒸發，然後再凝結回液態。我這個實驗所使用的物質是水。你能告訴我每個相變過程中所需或釋放的能量嗎？"

function.name: thermo_calculate_energy
function.description: Calculate the energy required or released during a phase change using mass, the phase transition temperature and the specific latent heat. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mass.description: Mass of the substance in grams.

substance.description: The substance which is undergoing phase change, default is 'water'

But the function only calculates one phase transition at a time. We need to call it four times.

We should provide the results. The function returns something. It doesn't specify units but typical latent heats: melting of water: 334 J/g, freezing releases same amount. Vaporization: 2260 J/g, condensation releases same. So for 500g: melting: 500*334=167000 J. Freezing: -167000 J (released). Vaporization: 500*2260=1130000 J. Condensation: -1130000 J. So we can compute those. The function might return numeric values. We'll call the function four times. Then we produce a response summarizing the energies. The user asked "你能告訴我每個相變過程中所需或釋放的能量嗎？" So we answer in Chinese. Provide the energies. Use the function calls.
